169.text: a man who sailed before the mast
The man who came with the barrow

quotes.text:
"Fifteen men on the dead man's chest--
             Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"and a pleasant sittyated
grog-shop. Much company, mate?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "this is the berth for me. Here you, matey,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"bring up alongside and help
up my chest. I'll stay here a bit,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"I'm a plain man; rum
and bacon and eggs is what I want, and that head up there for to watch
ships off. What you mought call me? You mought call me captain. Oh, I
see what you're at--there"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "You can tell me when I've worked through that,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "weather-eye open for a seafaring man with one leg"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"Fifteen men on the dead man's chest--
             Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum!
           Drink and the devil had done for the rest--
             Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown
